contents.label: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe – Booster Course Pass
Mario Kart 8 Deluxe – Booster Course Pass

gameplayPillars.title: Accessible racing depth
gameplayPillars.description: Drifting, mini-turbos, items and vehicle builds make it easy to start while leaving room for advanced techniques.

gameplayPillars.title: Huge multiplayer range
gameplayPillars.description: Supports four-player split-screen, up to eight via local wireless and up to twelve online.

gameplayPillars.title: Massive track selection
gameplayPillars.description: The base game is already content-rich, while the Booster Course Pass adds 48 remastered courses across six waves.

worldSummary: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe turns locations from the Mario universe and other Nintendo series into anti-gravity race tracks, with cups spanning original courses, retro remakes and the large Booster Course Pass collection.

storyChapters.title: Grand Prix
storyChapters.body: Race through engine classes and cups to unlock rewards and master each course.

storyChapters.title: Battle Mode
storyChapters.body: Dedicated arenas support Balloon Battle, Bob-omb Blast, Renegade Roundup and other competitive formats.

storyChapters.title: Booster Course Pass
storyChapters.body: Six waves expand the roster of tracks and characters, creating one of the largest Mario Kart selections ever.

features: Booster Course Pass adds 48 courses and extra racers
perfNotes: Solo and two-player split-screen target 60 fps at 1080p docked. Three- and four-player split-screen run at 30 fps. Handheld is 720p with a 60 fps target.
